h1: Custom Cardboard Food Gifts for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Cardboard Food Gifts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cardboard food gifts in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for corporate gifting and branded snack boxes.
introHtml: Cardboard food gifts offer a lightweight, eco-friendly packaging option that keeps contents secure during shipping. Whether you are sending branded s'mores kits to remote teams or snack boxes for client appreciation, cardboard mailers allow for full-surface decoration with your logo. These gifts are easy to customize with foil stamping or full-color print, making them ideal for bulk corporate orders that need to arrive intact and on brand.
heroAltText: Custom cardboard food gifts featuring branded s'mores kit mailer box with logo
